_about: LEAD-chi frozen ROI/atlas configuration (task P5b, 2026-09-25; revised 2026-09-26 for the final registration). Read by register_rois.sh and lx_common.py. Relative paths are relative to $LX (/path/to/Penn_LEAD/LEADchi); ${VAR} is expanded from the environment. Items marked VERIFY must be confirmed header-only after the approved A3 downloads / A5 copies, before the OSF registration is posted, and any change is logged in the registration.

MNI152NLin2009cAsym.source: TemplateFlow cache already on server (~/.cache/templateflow; copied into the tree under A5). If the brain mask is absent or a 0-byte placeholder, register_rois.sh builds it with SynthStrip (label-free, once).

MNI152NLin6Asym.source: as above; needed only because SUIT and JHU are distributed in FSL MNI152 (= MNI152NLin6Asym) space

template_to_template.method: antsRegistrationSyN.sh -t s between the two TemplateFlow 1 mm T1w brains (E3 finding A11 option b; label-free, no download)

cit168.version: CIT168_Reinf_Learn v1.1.0 (Pauli, Nili & Tyszka 2018, doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.63), CC BY 4.0

dentate._decision: D8: He et al. 2017 if its licence permits before posting, otherwise SUIT (E3 row 4.1: no public He 2017 release found). To switch, replace this block with the He 2017 file and indices and log it in the registration.
dentate.version: DiedrichsenLab/cerebellar_atlases Diedrichsen_2009 atl-Anatom (Diedrichsen et al. 2009; nuclei Diedrichsen et al. 2011, doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2010.10.035), CC BY
dentate.VERIFY: probseg layout assumed 4D with one volume per label in label order (volume = label - 1); confirm from atl-Anatom.tsv and the header before posting (E3 row 4.2)

dseg_fallback.use: only if the probseg download (A3-2) is declined: binary label maps, so the p >= 0.5 rule degenerates to the deterministic label; declared as a deviation

plic.version: JHU-ICBM-DTI-81 white-matter labels, as distributed with FSL 6.0.7.11 (read-only)
plic.VERIFY: label values from $FSLDIR/data/atlases/JHU-labels.xml (index = value - 1); confirm before posting

synthseg._about: FreeSurfer/SynthSeg label values (QSIPrep desc-aseg_dseg and mri_synthseg output). SynthSeg has no choroid-plexus labels 31/63 (E3 row 5.2), so the R2*-based choroid rule applies.

envelopes_ppb._source: v1.2 delta section 5.1 (literature ranges re-verified against the PDFs before posting, item S4); composites follow P5 constants.R

csf_ref._note: CSF-only secondary reference; a session without a valid CSF reference is missing for dref, K3 and the CSF level of the specification curve (no PLIC fallback)

_pe_axis: voxel axis of the phase-encode direction (R-L, 75 % phase FOV) for the ghost-to-signal index; VERIFY from InPlanePhaseEncodingDirectionDICOM / PhaseEncodingDirection counts in the header audit before posting

slab._note: partition axis = the unique voxel axis of length 96 (matrix 120 x 160 x 96)
